required.name: title
required.label: Collection name
required.why: Names what the list is, so the agent can tell the user which set of things it read.

required.name: item-count
required.label: Item count
required.why: Tells the agent how much of the list it is holding, and whether pagination hid the rest.

required.name: item-link
required.label: Item links
required.why: Without a resolvable URL per item the list is a dead end and the agent cannot go one level deeper.

recommended.name: price
recommended.label: Price per item
recommended.why: Per-item prices let the agent shortlist candidates without fetching every item page.

recommended.name: availability
recommended.label: Availability per item
recommended.why: Lets the agent drop items it cannot get before it spends a request on them.

recommended.name: description
recommended.label: Description
recommended.why: Says what the collection is for, so the agent can decide it is reading the right list.
